headline: Norwood Water goes before NWC Amended on Tuesday, September 22
blurb: The Norwood Water Commission meets September 22 with a full plate of water-related business. Six leak forgiveness requests are on the table — a recurring item for any small-system water utility, where a neighbor's faulty line can mean a bill that doesn't reflect actual use. The Commission will also take up a possible leak check fee, which would formalize how the system handles these situations going forward.
